review_type: Independent exact-frame Q versus foreground-isolated R2 comparison

findings.shelf: The earlier visible shelf-wave defect is resolved in these samples. Independent integer-offset comparison at eight shelf columns on each of five frames returned zero vertical shift everywhere. This does not assert subpixel or pixel-exact equality after delivery encoding.
findings.hair_and_ears: Hair and ears remain coherent. Enlarged peak-frame crops show no clear duplicated old-head silhouette, missing ear segment, or conspicuous dark halo. Soft boundary differences remain possible; native masks and unresolved-background counts do not establish a perfect matte.
findings.jaw_neck_and_collar: No clear jaw-to-neck discontinuity or collar seam is visible in the reviewed native-size pairs. Some neck deformation remains inherent in the spatial transition.
findings.mouth: Mouth shapes appear consistent with the matching Q frames under the intended rigid head translation. This is not an independent lip-sync verdict.

remaining_review: Normal-speed playback for edge shimmer, correction-onset/end rebound and owner judgment of reduced emphasis. Parent independently verifies audio and timestamps.
